summaryHi: यह योजना CarChuno होमपेज और उसके फॉर्म्स का विश्लेषण करने के लिए Playwright और Stagehand का उपयोग करती है, जिसमें सुरक्षा बाधाओं के लिए मानवीय जांच शामिल है।

steps.action: Initialize Playwright browser and navigate to https://www.carchuno.com using Stagehand's observe mode.
Monitor for Cloudflare, CAPTCHA, or mandatory login overlays that prevent DOM access.
Extract the homepage DOM structure and identify all <form> elements and their associated input fields.
Analyze form validation logic (required fields, data types) and inspect submission endpoints via network interception.
Compile a report of the site's interactive elements and metadata structure.

executionResult.title: CarChuno — Zero Spam. True On-Road Price. Autonomous Reverse Bidding Car Buying.

summaryHi: यह योजना CarChuno होमपेज और उसके फॉर्म्स का निरीक्षण करने के लिए है, जिसमें सुरक्षा बाधाओं के मामले में मानवीय हस्तक्षेप का प्रावधान है।

steps.action: Initialize Playwright and navigate to https://www.carchuno.com using Stagehand pattern.
Check for the presence of CAPTCHAs, Cloudflare challenges, or mandatory login overlays.
If a CAPTCHA or login wall is detected, pause execution for manual resolution.
Scan the Live DOM to identify all interactive forms, including search filters and contact fields.
Extract and log metadata for each form field (input types, labels, and validation requirements).
